in_arabic.name: خُفَيْر
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من خفر بمعنى الحاجب أو الساتر
in_arabic.long_meaning: خُفَيْر هو اسم مشتق من الفعل خفر، ويعني الحاجب أو الساتر. وقد ورد في بعض التفاسير القرآنية أن الخفر هو الحماية أو الستر، ومن ثم فإن اسم خُفَيْر يمكن أن يكون له دلالة على الحماية أو الستر الإلهي. وقد استخدم هذا الاسم في بعض الأوقات في العصور الإسلامية المبكرة كدلالة على التوكل على الله واللجوء إليه.

in_urdu.name: خفیف
in_urdu.meaning: خفیف کا مطلب حاجب یا ساتر سے ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: خفیف نام عربى جڑوں سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے حاجب یا ساتر۔ یہ نام اردو بولنے والے مسلمانوں میں شائع ہے اور اکثر اس کے روحانی معنی تحفظ یا الہی سایہ کے طور پر سمجھے جاتے ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: खुफैर
in_hindi.meaning: खुफैर का अर्थ है हाजिब या ساتर
in_hindi.long_meaning: खुफैर नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है हाजिब या ساتर। यह नाम हिंदू-मुस्लिम समुदाय में प्रयोग किया जाता है और इसकी आध्यात्मिक महत्ता है, जो ईश्वरीय संरक्षण और सायरे को दर्शाता है।

in_pashto.name: خفیفر
in_pashto.meaning: خفیفر د حاجب یا ساتر مطلب دی
in_pashto.long_meaning: خفیفر نوم د عربي ريښو څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې د حاجب یا ساتر دی. دا نوم د افغانانو او پښتنو په منځ کې کارول کیږي او ډیری وختونه د الهي حفاظت یا ساتنې معنا ته کارول کیږي.

in_english.name: Khufair
in_english.meaning: Khufair means protector, guardian or one who covers
in_english.long_meaning: The name Khufair is derived from the Arabic root 'kha-fa-ra', which means to protect or cover. In Islamic tradition, the name is associated with the concept of divine protection and guardianship. Historically, the name has been used in various Muslim cultures to signify a person who provides shelter or safeguard. The name Khufair holds spiritual significance, symbolizing a person's trust in God's protection and providence.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Khufair" holds a rich cultural significance as it is believed to have been derived from the Arabic word 'Khafarah', which means 'brightness' or 'shining'. In Middle Eastern cultures, naming children with illuminative names instills a sense of hope, positivity and prosperity. The brightness that this name signifies can be interpreted as a reflection of the distinctive quality or characteristic one may possess.
data.spiritual_significance: In the Islamic religious context, the name "Khufair" holds a profound spiritual significance as it is mentioned in the Quran as the name of a companion of Prophet Solomon (as). Khufair's unwavering loyalty, faith, and devotion to Prophet Solomon, as stated in Surah An-Naml, qualifies him as an exemplar of a virtuous servant of God. The spiritual significance of this name can therefore be interpreted as a reminder to strive for a strong bond and unwavering faith in Allah, embodying the noble qualities of submission, loyalty, and service to God and His Messenger.

historical_references.reference: Ibn Al-Athir records the battle of Khufain in his 'Al-Kamil fi al-Tarikh'. The battle took place in 633 CE during the early Islamic conquests under the Rashidun Caliphate, near the city of Khufain (Al-Kasr) in Iraq, against the Sassanid Empire.
historical_references.context: Early Islamic conquests under the Rashidun Caliphate against the Sassanid Empire

historical_references.reference: Al-Baladhuri, in his 'Ansab Al-Ashraf', details the story of Khufair ibn Al-Harith, a pre-Islamic Arab poet and leader, who was killed during the Battle of Mu'tah (629 CE) against the Byzantine Empire. He is said to have inspired many early Muslims with his poetry and courage.
historical_references.context: Battle of Mu'tah against the Byzantine Empire
